serializationRules.format: Canonical JSON with lexicographically sorted keys and sorted incident arrays (sorted by segmentIndex, then entityIdA, entityIdB)
serializationRules.guarantee: Deterministic byte-identical serialization across saves and reloads.

serializationRules.rule: Upon document reload, collision reports are deserialized without triggering re-computation. If underlying geometry hash changes, collision state is marked 'STALE_NEEDS_REVERIFICATION'.
